name: sdlc
description: Holds an AI coding agent, and the people directing it, to what was written down. Every change is planned before any code exists, challenged by a reader that never saw it written, approved by a person against the exact text, and proved from recorded evidence; a pull-request check refuses anything missing a link. The solution's rules and decisions live in the repository and carry from one cycle to the next, and whatever contradicts them is brought into the open.
